note: Approved Party Registry V1 database-contract clarifications after DATABASE_VALIDATION. normalized_value_hash is exactly 64 uppercase hexadecimal characters representing the tenant-isolated HMAC-SHA-256 result; lowercase, mixed case, prefixes and alternate encodings are invalid. NATURAL_PERSON display_name is normalized given_names plus one ASCII space plus normalized family_names; LEGAL_ENTITY display_name is normalized legal_name; normalization trims surrounding whitespace and collapses internal whitespace runs to one ASCII space while preserving case and diacritics; preferred_name and trade_name do not replace display_name. party_nationalities intentionally does not duplicate tenant_id because party_id identifies the globally unique Party and inherits tenant ownership. Active nationality uniqueness is (party_id, country_code) WHERE valid_until IS NULL; active primary uniqueness is (party_id) WHERE is_primary = true AND valid_until IS NULL. The DBML Flyway obligations and integration-test contracts are approved as written in the merged DBML.
